question:
**Simplify:**

[(26 div (2)/(2)) times left{6 div 2 times (12-2)/(2)right} div {5 times 6 div 3}]
solution:
**Given:**

**big[(26 div (2)/(2)) times {6 div 2 times (12-2)/(2)} div {5 times 6 div 3}big]**

**Calculations:**

⇒ (26 div (2)/(2)) times (6 div 2 times (10)/(2)) div (5 times 6 div 3)

⇒ (26 div 1) times (3 times 5) div (5 times 2)

⇒ 26 times 15 div 10

⇒ (390)/(10)

⇒ 39

**∴ Value = 39.**
